svg.title: How is codex-headless assembled around one Codex session?
svg.desc: The application prepares trust, the input profile and resume ownership before spawning Codex. The coordinator proves which rollout belongs to the pane before tailing it, then turns rollout records and optional proxy streams into strict semantic events.
